svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of foreign aid received that is climate-related 2010 to 2024
Committed bilateral official development assistance (ODA) that targets climate change mitigation, adaptation, or
both, as a share of the bilateral ODA received that is covered by the OECD's climate tracking.

tspan.tspan: Projects that target climate as a secondary objective are counted at their full value. The OECD's climate tracking excludes general

text.tspan: budget support, debt relief, and some costs in donor countries, such as hosting refugees.
